definitions.explanation: The natural sciences as a school subject, typically including physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science.

examples.japanese: {理科|りか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{理科|りか}{室|しつ}→理科室：22704_rikashitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a class in the science room.

notes:
USAGE: Refers to natural sciences as a school subject, especially in elementary and middle school.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{理科|りか}{室|しつ}→理科室：22704_rikashitsu⟧ (science room/laboratory)
- {理科|りか}⟦{系|けい}→系：noentry⟧ (science track/field)
- {理科|りか}⟦{離|ばな}れ→離れ：10003_banare⟧ (decline in interest in science)

SCHOOL SUBJECTS:
- ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧ (Japanese language)
- ⟦{算数|さんすう}→算数：04170_sansuu⟧/⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧ (arithmetic/mathematics)
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (social studies)
- ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧ (English)

NOTE: In higher education, specific sciences like ⟦{物理|ぶつり}→物理：03609_butsuri⟧ (physics), ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧ (chemistry), ⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧ (biology) are taught separately.
